player_prompt.intro:
D kečč imiraz {player_id} yettawalen s {colour} ({piece}) deg urar n Othello.
Taqsiṭ-ik d aḥraz n ugar n ikeččen n tsemma-ik ɣef uḍebsi alamma d taggara n urar.
Di ṭṭurn-ik, ssekcem ikečč i wakken ad yejmeɛ ikeččen n imiraz-ik nniḍen deg yal tama (afellay, adday, neɣ azgen)-siḍen n ikečč amaynut-ik d ikečč nniḍen illan. Ikcčen n imiraz-ik nniḍen i yejmeɛen ad ṭṭfen tsemma-ik.
Fka ṭṭurn-ik s tsefṣit '[row, col]'.

board.no_valid_moves_reset: {observation} Ulac tikli i d-yettwaḥsab - ahat ilaq ad teǧǧeḍ.
board.no_valid_moves_step: {observation} Ulac tikli i d-yellan, ahat ad tεeddiḍ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Aḥezzeb ilaq ad yili s ṣṣenf [row, col].
invalid_move.illegal: Aḥezzeb ur nelli d azedgan. Iḥezzen i yellan: {valid}

game_message.must_skip: Amiraz {pid} ({piece}) ur yesɛa ara tawmalin ṣaḥiḥin d ahat yeḥrez ad isers.
